Chapter 6798: Too Easy

Chapter 6798: Too Easy

His eyes gleamed with a dreadful primordial light, capable of causing massacres and decapitating immortals.

“Sir, everyone is free to join or leave Heaven Assault. If these two friends wish to leave with you, then we naturally would not force them. We will meet again in the future.” He took a deep breath and bowed.

“Thank you.” The woman returned the gesture.

The middle-aged man didn’t do so since he didn’t join on his own accord. Of course, the alliance didn’t do anything unreasonable either.

“Are you satisfied with this, Sir?” He asked.

“This is my giving you face since I could destroy your alliance whenever I feel like it.” Li Qiye said.

Sheng Shengxian had seen shored immortals before, just never anyone with so much arrogance and aggressive words.

“I suppose it is our alliance’s luck.” He took a deep breath.

“Indeed, and it’s because you still have a brain. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be wasting words right now.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Sir, do you think you can kill all the immortals, the highest beings since the start of time?” He couldn’t help but ask.

“Is this not the case? I’m not boasting, but since my personality has changed, I don’t kill as wantonly anymore. If I were younger, ten Heaven Assault Alliances would have been reduced to dust.” Li Qiye said.

“If you are this unbeatable, Sir, why don’t you attack the heaven?” He changed the topic.

“How do I know that is not part of my plan? Go ask Genesis about his plan, perhaps he’s waiting for me to do so.” Li Qiye said.

“Are you telling the truth, Sir?” He froze for a moment before asking.

“As I said, ask Genesis.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Sir, I don’t know where our leader is, he is a reclusive dragon.” He shook his head.

“More like a dragon hiding and waiting to take advantage of the situation. He doesn’t dare to come out now.” Li Qiye said.

“...” He shuddered with rage because Genesis was highly respected: “Sir, our leader is the wisest visionary I have seen.”

“That’s your business, I hope he is what you described because anything less, he would bring all of you down with him.”

His expression changed several times upon hearing this.

“Okay, since you’re smart enough today, we’re done today. I thought I could use this as an opportunity to end your alliance, I guess not.” Li Qiye said with a smile and began to leave.

“Thank you for taking it easy on us.” He composed himself and said: “If I may have a question, Sir?”

“What?” Li Qiye stopped.

“It is too easy to become an immortal in Heavenrealm, for some.” He said.

“Hasn’t that always been the case?” Li Qiye asked.

“That’s not what I meant, sir. In history, Heavenrealm was blessed by the high heaven. Becoming overlord and even grand immortal was not challenging compared to the minor worlds. Only the latter realms are difficult to reach.” He said.

“And?” Li Qiye smiled.

“I try not to be prejudiced but in my opinion, the current immortal path is biased.” He said.

“In what sense?” Li Qiye asked.

“Perhaps the process’ difficulty is the same for the inhabitants but easier for those from the nine worlds and thirteen continents.” He said.

“They’re just insects compared to the natives, food even. They are wild chickens, a different taste compared to the domesticated ones.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Now, Heavenrealm is becoming their world. How would you explain this, Sir?” He asked.

“How do I know? I’m not from Guardian Alliance. Perhaps they have a secret cultivation method.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I do not believe there is a different cultivation method. In my opinion, the primordial tree is biased.” He said.

“Go on.” Li Qiye said.

“Ever since Eternal Sacred Teacher’s dao spread, the primordial tree is biased towards those from the nine worlds, not the other three thousand worlds.” He said.

“If that’s the case, what are the others cultivating with? They have their own tree?” Li Qiye asked.

“Buzz.” Li Qiye focused his gaze, causing Sheng Shengxian’s tree to appear.

“!!!” He became alarmed and staggered backward.

“If your tree’s power flows back to the worlds, how many immortals can come from it?” Li Qiye asked.

“Hmm...” As a peak primordial immortal, his power would nourish numerous emperors and ancient ancestors. However, the exact number of immortals couldn’t be ascertained.

“What is the key behind the success of those from the nine worlds?” Li Qiye asked.

“What is it?” He asked.

“Their dao heart, it is harmonizing with the primordial tree. Don’t blame the earth for being too dry just because you’re constipated. It just means the path you’ve taken was too easy.” Li Qiye said and then left, leaving Sheng Shengxian in a daze.
